ops.title: SHIP GATE (v0.21): if the poll handler needs owned paging, restore wrappers + both idx_*_owner together, pre-ship
ops.description:
Conditional gate on the cc-pool daemonkit v0.21 ship. Act on it or close it
before cc-pool's v0.21 tag; it is meaningless afterwards.

Commit e4d995b deleted the three owned-paging wrappers
(AccountMutationsOwnedBy, CredentialOperationsOwnedBy,
PendingAddReservationsOwnedBy) and dropped both idx_account_mutations_owner and
idx_credential_operations_owner from the schema. The ruling rested on an
empirical check: at the time, zero callers existed anywhere in the tree —
including internal/daemon's then-in-flight account_terminals_open.go and
crossera.go — and the poll's replay cursor pages terminal chunks, not
account_mutations rows.

**The open risk**: internal/daemon's OpAccountMutationPoll handler was still
being written when that ruling was made. If its replay cursor turns out to need
owner-scoped row paging, the wrappers AND both indexes must come back together,
in one commit, before the ship.

Why together: a half-change either reintroduces an unindexed `owner_record = ?`
scan (wrappers without indexes) or ships dead write-side cost (indexes without
callers).

Why pre-ship: the store is SchemaVersion = 1 with ErrSchemaMismatch,
fail-closed, and v0.21 is unshipped — so dropping and re-adding an index costs
nothing today. After the tag it costs a fourth incompatible schema epoch, which
backlog item 0896d69 (P1) already flags as an unresolved pain point with no
migration path.

Supporting facts verified at ruling time: `owner_record <> ?` cannot use either
index (no equality or range on the leading column); the ~10 `WHERE account_id=?`
queries do not depend on them, since account_mutations.account_id is
NOT NULL UNIQUE (auto-index) and credential_operations.account_id is
INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid alias).

ops.text: Either: cc-pool v0.21 ships with OpAccountMutationPoll's replay cursor confirmed NOT to need owner-scoped row paging (close as resolved-by-nonoccurrence)
Or: a single pre-tag commit restores all three *OwnedBy wrappers AND both idx_account_mutations_owner / idx_credential_operations_owner together
No cc-pool ship proceeds with the wrappers gone and either index present, or either index present with no caller
